purpose: webxr1: Safari/WKWebView pages black. WebKit's GPU process renders page tiles into 'w30r' IOSurfaces as Metal 554 (BGR10_XR); the kernel makes them 'BGRA', Nord2Metal refused 550-555 and the library had no such formats -> nothing drawn. Now 550-553 = B8G8R8A8, 554/555 = B8G8R8X8 (sRGB variants sRGB). Switch /var/db/nord2-metal/no-webxr = old refusal. Log line 'NORD2_RW I WEBXR webxr1 on' once per process that imports an XR surface.
